abstract: An investigation was made of thyroid function in 20 patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Two patients were judged to be overtly thyrotoxic on the basis of the symptoms and physical findings; both patients had widely metastatic choriocarcinoma, markedly increased serum T4 levels (21.4 and 27.7 micrograms/100 ml), and extremely high levels of serum human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) (3,220 and 6,720 IU/ml) relative to those of normal gestation(< 100 IU/ml). Three other patients had moderately increased serum T4 levels (13 to 17.1 micrograms/100 ml), moderately increased serum hCG levels (110 to 310 IU/ml), and findings on clinical examination which suggested euthyroidism. Using the mouse thyroid bioassay, we found that the biologic characteristics of the thyroid-stimulating factor were those of purified hCG, and that the levels of thyroid-stimulating activity in both serum and urine correlated closely with the levels of hCG. These results provide evidence that the thyroid-stimulating activity intrinsic to the hCG molecule plays the central pathophysiologic role in choriocarcinoma-associated thyrotoxicosis.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の患者20例で甲状腺機能を調べた。臨床所見から明らかに甲状腺中毒症と判断された患者は2例で、いずれも広範に転移した絨毛癌であった。両例とも血清T4値が著しく上昇し(21.4および27.7μg/100ml)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の血清値は正常妊娠時(100IU/ml未満)と比べて極めて高値(3,220および6,720IU/ml)であった。他の3例は血清T4値が中等度に上昇し(13〜17.1μg/100ml)、血清hCG値も中等度に上昇していた(110〜310IU/ml)が、臨床所見からは甲状腺機能正常と考えられた。マウス甲状腺バイオアッセイを用いたところ、甲状腺刺激因子の生物学的特性は精製hCGのそれと一致し、血清および尿中の甲状腺刺激活性はhCG値と密接に相関した。これらの結果は、hCG分子に内在する甲状腺刺激活性が、絨毛癌に伴う甲状腺中毒症において中心的な病態生理学的役割を果たすことを示している。
